productsList.title: Metre2 Mileage Tracker
productsList.description:
Logs business mileage for tax and expense claims for sole traders and freelancers, from a Windows
desktop app - date, purpose, from/to, vehicle and miles, one row per trip.

An always-visible tax-year dial sits above everything else: a radial gauge showing progress toward
the UK HMRC AMAP threshold (45p/mile for the first 10,000 business miles in a tax year, 25p after
by default - both editable), with business miles logged, claim value so far and your current
per-mile rate alongside it. Step back through past tax years with prev/next navigation. Every
trip's claim value is worked out automatically from your cumulative mileage that tax year - the
trip that tips you over the threshold has its value split correctly between the two rates, no
manual calculation needed.

The Log tab reads as a journal, not a spreadsheet - trips grouped by month, each one a compact
route line with purpose and vehicle tags, miles and value. "+ Log trip" opens a quick form for
date, purpose, from, to, vehicle and miles; the pencil icon on any entry opens the same form to
edit it. Search by purpose, from or to, filter by vehicle or purpose, or flip the newest/oldest
toggle, to find what you're looking for fast.

Switch to the Vehicles tab for a ranked leaderboard - miles, trips and claim value for each vehicle
you track, colour-coded and sorted by claim value. The Summary tab rolls the current log up into a
dashboard: total claim value as the headline figure, total miles, average trip, your most-used
vehicle, the date range covered, and a table of totals for every tax year you've logged trips in.

Trips persist between sessions, so the log is a running record that builds up over time. Your
currency symbol, mileage rates/threshold and vehicle list are all editable in Settings - defaults
match UK HMRC AMAP rates for cars and vans, but adjust them for other vehicle types or your own
figures.

When you need the record, export the whole log as a CSV file or a formatted PDF - for your own
files, an accountant, or a tax return.

The sample data leans towards trade and site work, but nothing enforces it - any sole trader or
freelancer who claims business mileage can use it.

productsList.title: Dropshipping Store Business Guide
productsList.description:
Dropshipping is one of the most exciting work from home opportunities and online business strategies there is today. Nowadays the shopping world is going online, and it’s just the beginning of the revolution - so if you are interested in creating your own online business, you’re in the right place and in the right time. 
We have a full practical business building journey for you, teaching step by step how to start a drop shipping business, starting with the basics and getting to pro level there.

The app provides a set of tools to support your journey:
* In-app notebook to work on your practical exercise, niche searching, track your progress, customized ideas, and successes.
* In-app goal setting questionnaire.
* In-app scheduling system to help you be consistent and complete the journey.
* News Feed - Stay updated with new thoughts, ideas, tools, and tips with the live news feed feature.
* Audio Music player with study focus music.
* High end lessons and useful calculators.

📦  What is dropshipping?
Dropshipping is the method of shipping products straight to your customers coming from a third-party distributor or supplier, without having an intermediary step (like storing the products at your physical business location).
In other words, dropshipping is the act of selling a product on your website without actually handling the order fulfillment and delivery. Another advantage of dropshipping is that you will not pay for the goods until the customer pays for it, making dropshipping an appealing option for people who don't want to risk buying products that won't easily sell. This low barrier to entry allows amateurs and experts alike to pick a niche and run their own dropship-based ecommerce store.
This is drop shipping explained in 4 simple steps:
Step 1 - You list the supplier's product on your store for buyers to purchase.
Step 2 - The customer purchases something from your eCommerce store.
Step 3 - You order that exact same product that your customer paid for from your supplier.
Step 4 - Your drop shipping supplier deliver this item directly to your customer

📦  eCommerce Dropship Business Models
We’ll walk you through the different ways to make money online. As far as internet-based business models go, the most prominent are eBay, Amazon, Shopify, and building your own eCommerce store. We will show you the pros and cons, and help you decide. For some Shopify is the best, while for others eBay or amazon makes the best vehicle to your future business needs.

📦 How To Find Products To Sell Online
Your next step is to look for products to sell. There are three main things we will talk about:  Importing (from Alibaba, China or elsewhere), Arbitrage (This is the process of going to local estate sales, flea markets, or garage sales to search for items that you could sell online for revenue) , Domestic Suppliers (looking for suppliers that have products to sell and they're trying to find people to resell their goods for them).

📦 Drop Shipping Step by step - 7-step procedure that is used every single time to set up an eCommerce store:
Step 1- Choose A dropship Niche
Step 2 - Research Competitors
Step 3 - Create Your Store
Step 4 - Get Approved with suppliers
Step 5 - Optimize Your Drop Shipping Website For Conversions
Step 6 - Get Paid Traffic
Step 7 - Outsource & Automate

📦 What are the benefits of dropshipping?
With drop shipping, there’s no necessity to store inventory on hand, which saves your business the (time, labor and monetary) and expenses of manufacturing and organizing the products yourself and managing your own storage facility property to stock them. We will  go into details and understand the drop shipping benefits 

📦  What are the pitfalls of dropshipping?
In such manner, drop shipping seems so appealing that it appears like everybody want to make it happen, right? There are many typical mistakes you may do. Learn what they are.

📦  Drop Shipping on eBay
Should eBay even be an option for dropship? Learn in this lesson.

📦 Drop Shipping on Amazon
The second dropship option is Amazon. Pros and cons, competition and more.

📦 Owning Your Own Dropshipping Store
The third alternative is to create your own eCommerce store using Shopify or other platforms. This is the dropshipping model that what consistently recommend. 

So, what are you waiting for? This is the best opportunity you’ll ever get! It is a high quality course that usually costs hundreds of dollars or more. Get it now for free!
